name: tripadvisor-mcp
description: TripAdvisor location search, details, photos, and reviews for Claude via the Terra API

tripadvisor_api_key.title: TripAdvisor Terra API Key
tripadvisor_api_key.description: Your TripAdvisor Terra API key (create one at tripadvisor.com/developers). Needed by the ta_search_*/ta_get_* Terra tools; ta_web_get_location and ta_web_healthcheck work without it.

tripadvisor_cache_ttl.title: Search cache TTL (optional)
tripadvisor_cache_ttl.description: Seconds to cache search responses (default: 300; `0` disables).

tripadvisor_request_timeout_ms.title: Browser-bridge timeout (optional)
tripadvisor_request_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout for the optional browser bridge (default: 30000).

tripadvisor_debug_log.title: Browser-bridge debug log (optional)
tripadvisor_debug_log.description: Set to `1` to log browser-bridge requests to stderr.

tripadvisor_ws_port.title: Bridge port override (optional, tests only)
tripadvisor_ws_port.description: Bridge port override (default: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT, else 37149). Tests only.

fetchproxy_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (optional, advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_port.description: Localhost concentrator port (default 37149). On one machine every MCP shares the concentrator, so move it for ALL of them or not at all.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind host (optional, advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (optional, advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Where to store the long-term identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity.

tools.name: ta_search_nearby
tools.description: Find TripAdvisor locations near a lat/long

tools.name: ta_get_location_details
tools.description: Get details for a location (rating, address, hours, amenities)

tools.name: ta_get_locations
tools.description: Get details for multiple locations in one batch call

tools.name: ta_get_location_reviews
tools.description: Get the most recent reviews for a location

tools.name: ta_web_get_location
tools.description: Get a location's details from the public page via the browser bridge (no API key)
